queries.description:
A map of query id to the {@link ReliabilityTimedDataSubquery} that will be executed.
The query id is used to identify the query in the result, and can be arbitrarily set.

title:
Allows a query of timed data to be defined, then executed.
Reliability timed data includes data from the following sources:
- {@link Sensor}s
- `ReliabilityAssetAlerts`, {@link ReliabilityAssetEvent}s, {@link WorkOrder}s,
and other persisted entities with a timestamp.
- Model Outputs
- Model Inputs
- {@link ReliabilityMetric}s

See usages of {@link ReliabilityTimedDataSubquery} for an exhaustive list.
name: ReliabilityTimedDataQuery
